components.name: Organisation preview link
components.description: Implemented in src/components/PreviewLink.astro. A dotted-underlined external anchor describes itself through its summary ID; a non-interactive role=tooltip contains a title, one sentence, and optional local imagery. Keyboard focus has a visible outline. Non-touch pointer entry opens one preview unless keyboard-visible focus is active; focus entry also opens one and closes others. Focus exit outside the wrapper closes it. Pointer movement preserves an unfocused preview inside the axis-aligned bounding corridor joining the link and tooltip rectangles, closing it outside; a focused preview is exempt. Escape closes all. Touch pointer events are ignored, leaving native navigation intact. Visibility changes immediately via data-open, without animation or timers. Placement is viewport-bottom-fixed unless both dimensions meet preview-above-link, when it is absolute above the relative link wrapper. Opening measures the card and keeps it fixed through data-detached if the anchored position would cross a 16px viewport gutter. Exact Tailwind classes and measurements are recorded in DESIGN.md; no standalone rendering snippet is supplied.
